items.title: John L. Jones Interview, 1972-06-05
items.q: Ernest Rogers come out of Belmont. Yeah. ... That was John Catney's drummer when I started playing with John. ... That was his drummer. That was his mid drummer.

ctx.x: Yeah, well, Ernest Rogers worked with Marnie. That's my friend. Yeah. He's a drummer. Yeah, he's from up here. Huh? He's from right in this neighborhood, Ernest Rogers. Ernest Rogers was from.
Ernest Rogers come out of Belmont. Yeah.
